text: This staff report is about a matter that the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends a U-turn prohibition on Sedgemount Drive between Pandora Circle and Daventry Road. This prohibition will reduce conflicts between all users and improve safety along this section of Sedgemount Drive which is a local road in the vicinity of Tredway Woodsworth Public School.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited eastbound and westbound U-turn movements at all times on Sedgemount Drive, between Pandora Circle and Daventry Road.
